# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs/{ref}

Get specified ref or filtered list of refs by prefix

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |

| ref | path | string | True |
